chose: Spans go home only once home says it serves this build (`servesNow() === "fits"`), as a week sent by points does (RR24, C681); until then they wait on the phone.
options: wait for home to serve this build
send whenever home answers, and read 404 as not yet
a separate epoch check for spans
gray: Home serves the routes from epoch 21; a build at a newer snapshot waits until home is at least as new, which can hold spans back after a release.
undo: Gate on home's epoch >= 21 for spans alone, through ./serves.
